n_auto_vts.description: Number of virtual terminals (VTs) to manage automatically. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: 6).

reserve_vts.description: List of VT numbers to reserve and not manage (e.g., [6] to reserve the sixth VT). Values are comma-separated in the config file when uncommented. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: [6]).

kill_user_processes.description: Whether to kill user processes when they log out. Accepts: yes, no, on-last-log. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: no).

kill_only_users.description: List of users whose processes will be killed on logout (if KillUserProcesses=yes). Empty means all users.

kill_exclude_users.description: List of users whose processes will be excluded from killing on logout. Default includes 'root'. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: ['root']).

handle_power_key.description: Action to take when power button is pressed. Accepts: ignore, poweroff, reboot, halt, kexec, suspend, hibernate, hybrid-sleep, suspend-hybrid, shutdown. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: poweroff).

handle_suspend_key.description: Action to take when suspend button is pressed. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: suspend).

handle_hibernate_key.description: Action to take when hibernate button is pressed. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: hibernate).

handle_lid_switch.description: Action to take when laptop lid is closed. Accepts: ignore, poweroff, reboot, halt, kexec, suspend, hibernate, hybrid-sleep, suspend-hybrid, shutdown. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: suspend).

handle_lid_switch_docked.description: Action to take when lid is closed while docked/externally powered (overrides HandleLidSwitch). In shipped default, HandleLidSwitchExternalPower defaults to 'suspend'; HandleLidSwitchDocked defaults to 'ignore'. Here we follow shipped default comments. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: ignore).

remove_ipc.description: Whether to remove user IPC objects (shared memory, etc.) on logout. Accepts: yes, no, on-last-log. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (example: yes).
